slides.texte_overlay:
solo challenges that
build quiet confidence

eat at the counter of
a busy restaurant

chat with the cook.
you're not waiting for anyone.

take yourself out
on your birthday

best table you can get.
you don't need a crowd to celebrate.

read in a café for an hour

no laptop. no plans.
one chapter, then one
new idea to think about.
slides.texte_sophia:
read in a café for an hour

no laptop. no plans.
one chapter, then one
lesson on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
spend one night camping

just you and the quiet.
the noise in your head
has nowhere to hide.

ride somewhere new

pick a direction. go.
get lost a little.

drive with no destination

one playlist. no map.
come back when you're ready.
